name: DecideCommunicationDomainProposal
transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 UnitOfWork; this command can only REJECT or DEFER a domain-fact proposal and never apply owning-domain mutation
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate -> insert command_receipt -> proposal/event/hold/retention writes -> audit/results -> commit
revision_effects: DEFER preserves proposal hold; REJECT terminally closes it; semantic repeat returns NO_CHANGE
